prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / compositing. Produce ONE horizontal THREE-PANEL REPAIR STRIP for existing xianxia card illustrations. Requested canvas 1536 x 512 pixels if supported, exact 3:1 aspect ratio, three equal square cells side by side with straight seams at one-third and two-thirds. No gutters, no frame, no border, no transparent space, no extra panels.

Reference image 1 is the 4x4 cards-03 atlas. Reference image 2 is the 4x4 cards-04 atlas. Preserve the painting style, dark jade mountain backdrops, antique gold materials, composition, lighting and identity of the specified three cells. These are targeted corrections of the PAPER SURFACES, not a new art direction.

LEFT CELL: Storm Script. Recreate reference image 1, bottom-right cell (row 4, column 4): a curling long ivory parchment scroll with bronze rolled ends spiralling in a blue-white wind, a few gold leaves. Preserve the spiral scroll silhouette. Change every part of the parchment to completely blank light ivory paper. No ink, no lines of marks, no faint symbols, no maps, no glyphs, no simulated handwriting. Only gentle natural paper fiber and blank shading.

MIDDLE CELL: Empty Sleeve. Recreate reference image 2, top-left cell (row 1, column 1): a flowing ivory robe sleeve with dark jade decorative trim billowing to the right, releasing and catching three drifting ivory paper slips. Preserve the sleeve and the airy motion. Make all paper slips completely blank ivory on both visible sides. No ink, no text-like texture, no writing. The fabric may retain its existing non-letter geometric embroidery.

RIGHT CELL: Feast of Scars. Recreate reference image 2, row 3, column 2: a fragmented crimson jade disk with luminous gold repair seams, encircled by three floating ivory page pieces and elegant gold-red energy trails. Preserve the red disk, chips and orbiting papers. Make every floating page entirely blank ivory, only soft paper shading and natural fiber. Absolutely no lettering, symbols, marks, maps or decorative pseudo-writing on the pages.

Each focal composition is centered and self-contained in its square. Nothing crosses the two seams. All three images must match the reference atlases' refined Chinese-fantasy painterly realism, crisp small-card silhouettes, ink-green shadows and luminous restrained highlights.

Strict final inspection rule: every paper area must be empty. There must be NO English text, NO Chinese characters, NO pseudoletters, NO printed lines, NO labels, NO numbers, NO UI and NO watermark anywhere in the strip. Do not draw the cell names or positions. Deliver only the three repaired artworks in the exact left-to-right order Storm Script, Empty Sleeve, Feast of Scars.
